description: Piano-learning and MIDI visualization desktop app with interactive chord tools, note editing, and audio export.
pre_install: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'Orfeo.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Orfeo.exe was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'resources\app.asar') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'resources\app.asar was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'resources\native\orfeo_audio.node') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'resources\native\orfeo_audio.node was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'resources\native\orfeo-review.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'resources\native\orfeo-review.exe was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
notes: Use scoop update orfeo to update this installation. Orfeo's own update button opens the vendor download page instead of updating the Scoop-managed files.
The bundled GSAP library has an additional Section 7 permission; see LICENSE.md and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
